City Watch: The Lantern Files - voices and crowd

All CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from OpenGameArt.
Prepared with tools/make-voice-sounds.py: silence trimmed, levelled, short fades,
mono MP3. The troll voices are pitched down 7-8 semitones. The crowd is a 25-second
excerpt, low-passed at 2.6 kHz and crossfaded to loop.

suspect-1..5, down-1   "5 Hit Sounds + Dying" - TinyWorlds
                       https://opengameart.org/content/5-hit-sounds-dying
suspect-6..8, troll-1..2  "Pain sounds by EmoPreben" - EmoPreben
                       https://opengameart.org/content/pain-sounds-by-emopreben
troll-3                "5 Hit Sounds + Dying" (hit3) - TinyWorlds
officer-1..3           "Male Grunt/Yelling sounds" (3grunt3-5) - HaelDB
                       https://opengameart.org/content/male-gruntyelling-sounds
officer-4..5           "Hurt Sound Effects" (hurt_03, hurt_05) - EZduzziteh
                       https://opengameart.org/content/hurt-sound-effects
officer-6..7, down-2   "15 vocal male strain/hurt/pain/jump sounds" (slightscream-05, -07, -10) - qubodup
                       https://opengameart.org/content/15-vocal-male-strainhurtpainjump-sounds
crowd-loop             "Crowd Shouting/Speaking Ambience" - StarNinjas
                       https://opengameart.org/content/crowd-shoutingspeaking-ambience

suspect   a suspect taking a blow
officer   an officer taking a blow
troll     a troll taking a blow
down      someone going down
crowd     onlookers during a fight
